GracePrinciples.Principle: Contract-first changes: clarify scope and verification before implementation.
Keep semantic anchors stable and grep-friendly.
Use assertions, scopes, and tests as fresh completion evidence.
The model finds and explains; the script counts and checks. Nothing numeric or structural is left to model judgment.
No finding without evidence: a file and line on the reviewed commit, the reachability condition, and how to verify the fix.
One root cause is one finding, however many symptoms it has.
State limits honestly: what was not run or not read, and how that bounds the conclusion.
Do not strand existing review users: the skill keeps the name smart-review so installs upgrade in place, the diff review lives on as the changes section, and renamed modes stay understood.
